svg.title: paddock in tmux
svg.desc: Recorded from paddock 0.1.0 in a scratch tmux server; the sessions and agent output are staged. Steps: 1. Agents at work in your tmux. 2. prefix C opens paddock over your panes. 3. Type to narrow the list. 4. Tab shows every agent, grouped by state. 5. Enter jumps straight to the pane that is waiting.
